_note: An advice request keeps who asked, its decidiq decision and, once received, its outcome (DqZaakBesluiten Advies vragen, DqZaak Advies uitbrengen). AdviceService::requestAdvice writes these requests to adviesAanvraag, the schema AdviceRepository reads; `type` (intern/extern) is the request's kind and `subject` its subject. A fragment per ADR-037.

requestedBy.title: Requested by
requestedBy.description: The user who asked for the advice.

decisionRef.title: Decision reference
decisionRef.description: The decidiq advice decision this request is made in.
